name: Drunken Master
summary: A deliberately intoxicated martial artist who converts drink into fleeting ki, strength, courage, resilience, and fire.

features.name: Drunken Ki
features.summary: Drink alcohol as a standard action to gain a temporary ki point lasting up to 1 hour; while any remains, spend ki to take a safe 5-foot step.
features.scaling: maximum 1 point plus 1 every 2 levels after 3rd

features.name: Drunken Strength +1d6
features.summary: Spend drunken ki after a successful melee attack to add damage.

features.name: Drunken Courage
features.summary: Remain immune to fear while at least 1 drunken ki point remains.

features.name: Drunken Resilience DR 1/—
features.summary: Gain damage reduction while at least 1 drunken ki point remains.

features.name: Firewater Breath
features.summary: Drink and spend 4 ki to breathe a 30-foot cone dealing 20d6 fire damage, with a Reflex save for half.
